# Documentation update + full-suite verification

Final task for AH-0MUHMT5JC004WRSB (AC6, AC7).

## Goal

Document the shared mineral kill-drop code in the GDD and confirm the whole project is green.

## Minimal implementation

- Update `docs/Game Design Document.md` §4.4.1 to state that the kill-drop rule (small-asteroid single drop; non-asteroid 25–50 % re-drop) is implemented once in a shared helper used by both `PlayScene` and `GymFormationScene`.
- Update §6.4's `GymMinerals` entry (and any relevant file-breakdown lines) to reflect the shared helper and the wired drop behaviour.
- Update `README.md` if it references the mineral layer.
- Run the full suite plus typecheck/build; triage any failure through the triage skill.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC6 — Documentation updated.** The GDD (§4.4.1 and §6.4) and the gym docstrings describe the shared mineral kill-drop code.
- **AC7 — Full project test suite passes.** `npm test` (the full suite) passes and `npm run typecheck` succeeds.
- The GDD §6.4 `GymMinerals` entry and any `README.md` mineral wording are consistent with the wired gym behaviour.
- `npm run build` succeeds and no balance or tuning values are changed.

## Key Files

- `docs/Game Design Document.md` — §4.4.1, §6.4.
- `README.md` — if it references minerals.
- `src/scenes/gym/GymMinerals.ts`, `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.ts` — docstrings.

# Parity hardening and full-suite verification

**Parent:** AH-0MUVM9RAO004Y3LB. **Type:** task (verification).

## Summary
Add the cross-scene parity assertions for the new P3/P4 behaviour and run the
full project test suite, so the parent's parity, test-coverage and
"full suite passes" criteria are demonstrably met.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1 — `src/scenes/core/CombatScene.equivalence.test.ts` (duplicate-body guard)
  passes with the new shared P3/P4 pulse/absorb code, proving no per-scene copy
  diverges.
- AC2 — Game↔gym equality tests assert identical P3 absorb counts and P4 pulse
  behaviour between `PlayScene` and every gym that enables P3/P4.
- AC3 — The full project test suite (`npm test` / the project's canonical
  runner) passes with the new changes; any failure is triaged into a critical
  `test-failure` work item per the test skill.
- AC4 — A verification comment records the commands run and their results.

- Parent AC10 trace: **AC10 — Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.**
## Key Files
- `src/scenes/core/CombatScene.equivalence.test.ts`
- `src/scenes/__tests__/PlayScene.powerUpLevels.test.ts`
- gym parity test suites
- `src/powerups/effects.test.ts`, `src/powerups/powerUpLevels.test.ts`

## Dependencies
- F2, F3, F4, F5 — verification runs last.

**Parity assertions added (AC1/AC2)**

- Game↔gym equality: P4 ranged pulse (in-range cleared, out-of-range spared) identical in `PlayScene`, `GymFormationScene` and `GymPowerUpsCombat`; P3 multi-hit absorption resolves the same remaining count and pops after the same number of hits in `PlayScene`, `GymFormationScene`, `GymPowerUpsUtility` and `GymPowerUpsCombat` (214 in-range/out-of-range bullets and absorb-count checks).
